What I do for brands

    Sourcing consultancy

    Orders tracked from confirmation to shipment, with one contact who speaks both the brand's and the factory's language.

    AI workshops for textile companies

    Practical training for teams in the Portuguese textile and clothing industry, online or in person.

About me

I am an independent textile agent based in Santo Tirso, in the heart of Portugal's textile and clothing industry.

I work as the link between European brands and the factories that make their product. My focus is outdoor and casual apparel, and I know the manufacturers of the northern corridor first hand.

Alongside the Portuguese factories, I work with production partners in Asia for workwear, outdoor and casual lines.

  • Outdoor, performance and casual apparel
  • Portuguese factories, plus partners in Asia
  • Certified trainer for industry workshops

How a project runs

  1. 01

    Brief

    You tell me the product, target price, volumes and timing.

  2. 02

    Match

    I shortlist the factories that fit and introduce you.

  3. 03

    Sample and cost

    Prototypes and cost sheets, revised until both sides agree.

  4. 04

    Produce

    I follow the order on site until it ships.
